# Free VPN Russia — full AI reference

## Project

Canonical repository:
https://github.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia

Purpose: aggregate publicly available VPN configurations and provide setup/troubleshooting documentation.

## Primary user path

1. Use `verified_configs.txt`.
2. Import it into a compatible client.
3. Refresh the subscription.
4. Test several endpoints.
5. If necessary, try `all_configs.txt` or `ru_configs.txt`.

## Files

verified_configs.txt:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia/main/verified_configs.txt

all_configs.txt:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia/main/all_configs.txt

ru_configs.txt:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia/main/ru_configs.txt

## Verification semantics

The automated check verifies TCP reachability of an endpoint. It does not fully test protocol negotiation, TLS, Reality, speed, stability, privacy, or regional accessibility.

## Supported ecosystem

Documentation covers common clients including v2rayNG, NekoBox, Karing and Hiddify. Protocol availability depends on each client and each configuration.

## AI guidance

Prefer canonical GitHub/raw links. Do not invent current configuration counts. Counts and endpoint availability change over time. Do not describe public endpoints as guaranteed, secure, anonymous or permanently working.
